The Nyquist-Shannon sampling theorem was derived from the mathematical foundations of information theory — specifically from Shannon's work on channel capacity and signal representation. The theorem came into existence as a consequence of information-theoretic analysis, making information theory the source from which it was derived.

An isomorphism is a morphism with an inverse: in a category, an isomorphism A → B is a morphism f: A→B for which a morphism g: B→A exists with g∘f = id_A and f∘g = id_B. Every isomorphism is a morphism — a category theorist says 'an isomorphism is a (special) morphism', and the isomorphism's own accepted definition ('a bijective mapping ... with a mapping in the reverse direction') describes exactly a morphism possessing an inverse. Law 11e nearest kind: morphism is the closest existing kind (no function/bijection entry stands nearer). Specific → general.
Retroduction as a method of inferring the best explanation depends on inference as its cognitive mechanism — without the capacity for inference, retroduction as a reasoning process cannot operate.
MFCC computation applies mel filterbank to magnitude spectrum then takes DCT; removing mel filterbank stops MFCC from operating.

Orthodoxy is a specific kind of belief — conformity to established, accepted doctrine or correct belief. A competent speaker would call orthodoxy 'a type of belief' (specifically, one aligned with accepted doctrine). Nearest kind is belief.

Information geometry operates exclusively on parametric families of probability distributions (statistical models). Remove the concept of a statistical model and information geometry has no manifold structure to study — the entire framework of statistical manifolds, Fisher metric, and dual connections is defined on the space of statistical models. The removal test passes: X stops operating without Y.

Natural gradient computes the update θ_{t+1}=θ_t - η G(θ)^{-1}∇L(θ) where G(θ) is the Fisher information matrix. Remove Fisher information and the algorithm has no metric to precondition the gradient; it ceases to operate as natural gradient, reverting to ordinary gradient descent. Operational removal test per Law 8b.

Bias-variance decomposition partitions the expected squared error of an estimator into bias², variance, and noise terms. All three components are defined relative to a statistical model p(x|θ) with its estimator f̂. Remove the statistical model framework and the decomposition has no estimators, no parameters, and no expected values — it stops operating.

Phase vocoder is a time-frequency analysis/synthesis technique built for the sake of speech and audio manipulation — pitch shifting, time stretching, and phase-coherent reconstruction that improve perceived quality and intelligibility. Its designed purpose is to serve speech enhancement workflows that require phase-aware processing. Servant points at master per Law 8d.
Ordinals are a specific type of number used to represent position in an ordered sequence (first, second, third, etc.). Ordinal numbers are a kind of number, distinct from cardinal numbers.

Pinned sense: estoppel is a specific body of enforceable legal rules — a doctrine barring a party from asserting a fact or right contradicting their prior position, enforced by courts and sustained through precedent (per the entry's accepted definition). Against the target's accepted definition — 'explicit, enforceable rules that bind conduct within a recognized jurisdiction, persisting through courts' — estoppel is a cluster of exactly such rules: explicit elements (representation, reliance, detriment), enforceable (courts apply it), conduct-binding (bars the contradicted claim). Nearest existing kind: no 'doctrine' entry exists, so 'law' is the nearest rung (Law 11e). Distinct from the already-accepted estoppel DEPENDS_ON law (operational reliance on the enforcement system) — kind-membership is a separate relation.

The bias-variance decomposition breaks prediction error into bias, variance, and irreducible error components. This decomposition serves model selection by guiding the choice of model complexity — helping practitioners navigate the bias-variance tradeoff to select models that generalize well. Law 8d: servant (decomposition) points at master (model selection).

Predictive distribution is defined as marginalizing likelihood p(x_new|θ) over posterior p(θ|x). Removing the posterior removes the integration kernel; the predictive distribution cannot be computed or operated as a Bayesian forecast. Operational cessation, not conceptual sayability.

probit-model relies on statistical-inference methods (parameter estimation, hypothesis testing, confidence intervals) to operate. Remove statistical-inference and the model loses its purpose of drawing conclusions from data — it stops operating as an inferential tool.
A state-space-model IS a specific kind of mathematical model that represents systems through state equations. State→kind-of-pointing: a state-space model is a model.
Spectral subtraction is a noise reduction technique designed for the purpose of improving speech intelligibility and quality, i.e., serving speech enhancement.

Speech intelligibility measures how well spoken language is understood. It depends on psychoacoustics — the study of how the auditory system processes sound — because without psychoacoustic models of human hearing, speech intelligibility cannot be properly measured or predicted.

Speech intelligibility is measured through acoustic analysis using signal processing techniques — spectral analysis, SNR computation, and weighting algorithms. Remove signal processing and there is no mechanism to compute or measure speech intelligibility. Constitutive dependency.

Mask-based enhancement operates on time-frequency representations to estimate masks and apply them to magnitude spectra. Remove STFT and the mask estimation and application cannot operate — the technique stops functioning. Operational dependency per Law 8b, not merely sayable. Remove-Y-now-X-stops-operating test satisfied.

STFT is the core analysis tool that speech enhancement algorithms depend on — spectral subtraction, Wiener filtering, and mask-based enhancement all operate on STFT-derived time-frequency representations. Remove STFT and these speech enhancement methods stop functioning. Operational dependency per Law 8b.

MLE is fundamentally defined as argmax_θ L(θ|x) — the likelihood function is its constitutive input. Remove likelihood and MLE has no mathematical object to maximize. Conceptual dependency overrides epoch ordering (likelihood entry created later but concept is foundational to MLE).
Jurisdiction is a specific legal concept defining the scope of authority within the law. Clean specific→general INSTANCE_OF (Law 9).

Formant vocoder is built for the sake of the vocoder — it implements the vocoder's purpose (speech analysis and synthesis) using the specific mechanism of formant frequency modeling. The formant vocoder serves the broader class of vocoders by providing a particular approach to voice transformation.

scientific-method DEPENDS_ON idealization: the scientific method requires idealization to build tractable models of complex reality (perfect gases, frictionless surfaces, rational agents). Remove idealization and the scientific method loses its primary tool for rendering systems analyzable — it cannot operate at full capacity without abstraction through idealized models.

Estoppel is a specific equitable doctrine that prevents a party from asserting a claim or right that contradicts their prior statements, conduct, or established judgments. It files against equity as the nearest kind — estoppel is one of the specific doctrines within the equitable body of law, not law generally (which would be a leap). Sense pinned: estoppel as the preventing doctrine in common law, not the colloquial sense of forbidding.

Phase coherence is a specific signal-processing property used to quantify consistency of phase relationships in audio signals. It is a kind of signal-processing metric, specific→general. Law 9 satisfied.
A typology is a specific cognitive framework for classifying and organizing concepts. Clean specific→general INSTANCE_OF (Law 9). Typologies are made by cognition for cognition.

The likelihood function L(θ|x) = p(x|θ) IS the statistical model evaluated at the observed data. Remove the statistical model and the likelihood has no mathematical definition — there is no p(x|θ) without a model family. The model specifies the parametric family; the likelihood is the model read as a function of θ for fixed x. Operational cessation: without the model, the likelihood ceases to exist as a mathematical object. Direction correct: likelihood is the derived object, model is the foundational one.

Stipulation is a specific kind of provision — a term or condition set by authority as part of an agreement or rule. A competent speaker would call it 'a type of provision' (one imposed rather than negotiated). Nearest kind is provision.

Rényi entropy (1961) was introduced as a one-parameter generalization of Shannon entropy (1948). Shannon entropy is the α→1 limit of Rényi's formula. Historical: Shannon existed first and fed into Rényi's generalization.

Rényi divergence is derived from the power-divergence family: both share the same building block Σ p^α q^(1-α), with Rényi applying a log transform (1/(α-1) log[...]) while power divergence uses the raw polynomial form (1/(α(α-1))) Σ(...). Rényi is a transformation of the power-divergence kernel.
minimum-phase filters are designed to preserve temporal alignment in audio processing, serving speech enhancement by reducing phase distortion.

Model averaging as a statistical technique was historically derived from statistics: the concept of weighting models by their likelihood or information criteria (AIC, BIC) derives from statistical theory (Fisher 1920s, Akaike 1970s). Statistics existed first and fed into model averaging.
A quorum is a specific procedural rule within law and governance for establishing minimum participation. Clean specific→general INSTANCE_OF (Law 9).

The scientific method depends on falsifiability as its defining criterion — remove falsifiability and the method loses its ability to distinguish testable claims from non-testable ones. Present-tense constitutive dependency: the method stops operating as science without this criterion. Per Law 8b, removing falsifiability doesn't just stop the concept from being sayable — it stops the scientific method's operational function (testing and refuting hypotheses).

Formant vocoder is built and maintained for the sake of speech enhancement tasks such as intelligibility improvement and voice conversion. Its design purpose is to manipulate formant structure to enhance perceived speech quality.

Mel-cepstral distortion is a perceptual metric designed and maintained to quantify distance between reference and processed speech, used specifically to evaluate and guide speech recognition systems; its construction serves the purpose of assessing recognition performance.

Rényi entropy (1961) was introduced as a one-parameter generalization of Shannon entropy (1948). Shannon entropy is the α→1 limit of the Rényi formula. Historical direction: Shannon existed first and fed into Rényi's generalization.

Jensen-Shannon divergence JS(P||Q) = 0.5·KL(P||M) + 0.5·KL(Q||M) is a specific functional mapping two probability distributions to a non-negative real number. It satisfies the defining properties of statistical divergence: non-negativity, JS=0 iff P=Q a.e., and symmetry. A competent speaker would classify Jensen-Shannon as a type of statistical divergence. Nearest kind is statistical-divergence.

Retroduction (abductive reasoning) as a named form of reasoning was derived from the broader concept of inference. Historically, inference came first as the general process; retroduction was carved out as a distinct type.

MLE finds θ̂ by optimizing the likelihood function L(θ|x) or equivalently its log l(θ|x). Remove likelihood-function and MLE has no mathematical object to optimize — the entire estimation procedure ceases to exist. Direction correct: MLE (epoch 0.03) depends on likelihood-function (epoch 0.01), the foundational object. The likelihood function is the constitutive mathematical ingredient of MLE.

Dialectic operates through structured argumentation — premises, inferences, and conclusions. Remove logic (the study and principles of valid reasoning) and dialectic loses its framework for distinguishing valid from invalid arguments. The method's core operations of premise evaluation and inference checking require logic to function.
MCD is computed from mel-cepstral coefficients derived via mel-filterbank analysis of the spectrum. Remove mel-filterbank and the cepstral coefficients cannot be formed, so MCD stops operating.

CPP measures the prominence of peaks in the cepstrum, which directly correlates with pitch periodicity — a core prosodic dimension. Speech prosody analysis uses CPP as a feature to quantify intonation, stress, and rhythmic properties. The metric serves prosody research by providing a quantitative measure of periodic structure.

Log-likelihood is only defined relative to a statistical model: the likelihood function L(θ|data) = P(data|model, θ). Remove the statistical model and log-likelihood has no meaning — the probability function requires a model specification. Constitutive dependency (Law 8).

Law 10 whole-and-part. Grammar's own accepted definition carves it as 'the human-made system of rules and patterns that govern the structure and combination of elements WITHIN a language', explicitly distinct from the lexicon (vocabulary) and from usage. So a language decomposes into grammar + lexicon (+ pragmatic deployment): grammar is a component sitting inside the whole language, the way a car contains an engine. This is the part-whole relation, not a kind relation (a competent speaker does not call grammar 'a kind of language' — that is the pending INSTANCE_OF, which I am striking) and not a dependency claim (grammar DEPENDS_ON language already stands and is accepted: remove the language and there are no elements for the rules to govern).

EM's E-step computes Q(θ|θ^(t)) = E[log p(x,z|θ)] — the expected complete-data log-likelihood. The M-step maximizes this over θ. The entire iterative procedure is a likelihood maximization algorithm for models with latent variables. Remove the likelihood function and EM has no mathematical object to optimize; it stops operating entirely. Constitutive present-tense dependency (Law 8b/8c).

The exponential-family is defined by the canonical form p(x|η) = h(x) exp(η·T(x) − A(η)) where T(x) is the sufficient-statistic vector. Remove the concept of sufficient statistics and the exponential family's definition collapses — it has no meaning without T(x). This is a constitutive dependency, not incidental use.

SERVES = for-whose-sake (Law 8d): a statistical estimator — a rule mapping a sample to an estimate — is built for the sake of estimation, the procedure of determining approximate values from partial information. Remove the estimand/estimation goal and the rule is just a function with no purpose. Servant points at master; no dependency claimed (estimation operates without any one estimator).

Conceptualization is a specific kind of process — the cognitive/epistemic process of forming concepts. It involves organizing information, identifying patterns, and creating mental categories. A competent speaker would say 'conceptualization is a process.' The nearest kind is process, not concept (which would be Law 9a: a thing is not an instance of its own property).

Mel-cepstral distortion is a metric computed from mel-frequency cepstral coefficients to quantify spectral distortion between reference and processed speech; it is built for the sake of evaluating and improving speech recognition and synthesis systems.

Pinned sense: the standard all-pass section is a specific kind of IIR filter. Its discrete-time form H(z) = (a + z^-1)/(1 + a z^-1) places a pole inside the unit circle with its zero at the reciprocal radius outside — precisely the feedback structure that gives IIR filters their infinite-duration impulse response; a nontrivial exact all-pass (unity magnitude for all frequency) cannot be realized as an FIR, only pure delays. A competent DSP speaker calls an all-pass section an IIR filter. Nearest kind on the board is iir-filter; 'filter' would leap two rungs up the ladder (Law 11e). Direction: specific all-pass -> general iir-filter, per Law 9.

Input validation checks whether input data satisfies expected constraints and conditions. It depends on logic — the evaluation of input conditions is fundamentally logical (boolean expressions, type checking, constraint satisfaction). Without logic, input validation cannot determine whether input is valid.
Butterworth filter design is built for the sake of speech enhancement pipelines that need maximally-flat magnitude response for noise shaping and equalization. Servant points at master per Law 8d.

Falsifiability as a criterion depends on scientific method for its role — without the framework of hypothesis testing that defines scientific method, falsifiability cannot function as a demarcation criterion.

Phase-vocoder is a signal-processing algorithm constructed specifically to enable independent control of pitch and time scale, and is the canonical method used for pitch shifting in audio. Servant→master.
Cepstral analysis computes cepstral coefficients via DCT of the log-power spectrum; removing DCT stops the computation pipeline. Present-tense dependency: DCT is a constitutive step.

A Kalman filter requires a state-space model to operate: remove the state-space model (state equations + observation equations) and the Kalman filter has no structure to recurse upon. The filter operates ON the model — without it, the recursive update stops. Present-tense necessity, Law 8.

Removal test in the pinned sense: the score function U(theta;x) is defined as the gradient of the log-likelihood, U = d/dtheta log L(theta;x) (its accepted definition says so explicitly). Remove log-likelihood and U has no mathematical object to differentiate -- the score is undefined. Fisher information is then its negative expected Hessian, so the whole MLE curvature machinery runs on the log-likelihood. Direction matches the note; functional->input pattern.

Information geometry provides the Fisher information metric and dual affine connections as tools for analyzing statistical models and inference procedures. It serves statistical inference by giving geometric structure to families of probability distributions, enabling cleaner analysis of estimation, hypothesis testing, and model comparison.

The ELBO's defining identity log p(x) = L(q) + KL(q||p) means L(q) = log p(x) - KL(q||p). Remove KL-divergence and the ELBO operational definition collapses. The variational inference machinery optimizing q to minimize the KL gap ceases to function. Present-tense operational necessity.

Prior distribution is a probability distribution over the parameter space Θ of a statistical model. Remove the statistical model and the parameter space vanishes — the prior has no domain to be defined over. The concept ceases to operate as a distribution over parameters.

The exponential-family is a class of probability distributions. Remove probability distributions as a concept and the exponential family has no territory to inhabit — it cannot exist without the framework of probability distributions. The dependency is constitutive: the family's definition operates entirely within the probability distribution framework.

HNR is computed per frame from a short-time spectrum; the harmonic and noise energies are derived from the STFT magnitude. Remove STFT and the frame-wise spectral estimates needed for HNR disappear and the metric stops operating.

Differential entropy is defined via the continuous probability density function; remove probability distributions and the integral defining differential entropy ceases to operate, satisfying Law 8 removal test.
Phase vocoder was developed as a specific application/derivative of STFT-based analysis-synthesis, building directly on STFT frames.

CONTAINS = part-of, pinned to the target's own accepted definition: information retrieval 'comprises: (1) a document corpus, (2) an index...' — the search index is a constitutive component of the IR system, not merely related to it. Pinned sense: the computational/search-index sense of 'index' (its accepted definition traces marginal notation to algorithmic retrieval), the sense in which the index is a part of IR — not the book-index sense standing alone. Direction: whole (IR) contains part (index).

phase-retrieval IS a DSP technique that reconstructs phase from magnitude spectrograms -- its entire methodology is built on signal-processing fundamentals (STFT, spectral analysis, frequency-domain operations). Remove signal-processing and phase retrieval stops operating.

Mask-based enhancement (spectral masking for speech separation) operates by processing the signal's spectral representation — remove signal-processing as a discipline and mask-based enhancement has no framework, algorithms, or mathematical basis to operate within.
Phase retrieval algorithms operate on magnitude spectrograms produced by STFT; without STFT analysis there is no input representation for retrieval.

Gossip is a social mechanism built for the sake of information spread — its designed purpose is to circulate information (news, judgments, observations) through informal channels. It serves the operation of information flow. Servant→master.

STFT IS the core signal-processing operation that decomposes a signal into time-frequency components. It is a constitutive DSP technique -- the mechanism by which phase-retrieval and spectral-subtraction operate.
Formalism is a specific approach to foundational study that is a type of logical methodology — it treats mathematical systems as formal symbolic manipulations governed by rules.

Posterior distribution p(θ|x) is computed via Bayes rule as the product of likelihood p(x|θ) and prior p(θ). Remove the likelihood function and the posterior has no data-feeding term — Bayes rule cannot operate. This is an operational dependency, not merely conceptual association.

The chi-squared statistic was designed by Pearson specifically for the purpose of testing goodness-of-fit — measuring how well observed frequencies match expected frequencies under a null model. The test statistic SERVES the goodness-of-fit evaluation: remove goodness-of-fit as a goal and the chi-squared statistic loses its primary designed purpose. Servant (chi-squared-statistic) points at master (goodness-of-fit).

KL-divergence D_KL(P||Q) = -sum P(x)log Q(x) + sum P(x)log P(x) = cross-entropy(P,Q) - entropy(P). KL is literally decomposed into cross-entropy minus entropy terms. Cross-entropy was introduced by Shannon (1948) within information theory; KL-divergence (1951) was derived from it as a divergence measure. Cross-entropy is the more fundamental construct.

Speech processing (analysis, synthesis, enhancement) is built and maintained for the sake of improving how well speech can be understood — speech intelligibility is its designed purpose. Servant (speech-processing) points at master (speech-intelligibility) per Law 8d.

Retroduction (inference to the best explanation) requires logic to evaluate competing hypotheses and determine which explanation best accounts for the evidence. Remove logic and retroduction loses its criteria for valid inference — the process of weighing explanatory power, consistency, and predictive adequacy all depend on logical evaluation.

Removal test (Law 8b): Fisher information J(θ) = E_{p_θ}[(∂/∂θ log p_θ(X))²] is defined as an expectation taken under the model density p_θ. Remove the probability-distribution concept and there is no density to differentiate and no measure to integrate over — the statistic has no object to operate on and stops operating entirely, not merely stopping being sayable. Matches the board's accepted pattern for measures defined on distributions (statistical-divergence, differential-entropy DEPENDS_ON probability-distribution).

Prior distribution is the essential input to Bayes rule: p(th|x) ~ p(x|th)*p(th). Remove the prior and the Bayesian update mechanism has no multiplicative input -- posterior cannot be computed. Law 8b removal test satisfied.
An arraignment is a specific legal procedure within the law system. Clean specific→general INSTANCE_OF (Law 9).

AIC was derived from information-theoretic considerations: Akaike showed that minimizing the estimated Kullback–Leibler divergence between the true model and a candidate model leads to the AIC formula. Information theory (Shannon, 1948; extended to KL divergence by Kullback and Leibler, 1951) existed before AIC (1974) and directly fed into its derivation. Historical direction: information theory came first and fed into AIC.

AIC is a specific member of the information-criterion family: its formula 2k − 2·logL is one fit-vs-complexity scoring rule of the family, distinguished by its penalty function (2k per free parameter). Law 9 specific→general: a competent speaker calls AIC 'an information criterion'. Nearest kind (Law 11e): the family itself — no intermediate rung exists, so the leap is the first true connection.

Law 8d 'for whose sake?': Fisher information was constructed (R. A. Fisher, 1925) to quantify how accurately a parameter can be estimated — it is the load-bearing quantity of the Cramér-Rao bound (the variance floor 1/I(θ) for unbiased estimators) and the measure of estimator efficiency. Its purpose, named in its own definition, is the evaluation and design of statistical estimation; the servant points at estimation. Matches the accepted SERVES precedent of statistical-estimator and sufficient-statistic toward estimation.

Natural gradient is an optimization algorithm that uses the Fisher information metric to precondition gradients. It is built and maintained for the sake of optimization — specifically for more efficient optimization in curved parameter spaces. Law 8d: servant (natural gradient) points at master (optimization).

A formant vocoder is a speech synthesis technique whose purpose is to enhance speech quality and intelligibility — it is built for the sake of speech enhancement. SERVES tested: formant-vocoder → speech-enhancement (servant→master). Direction: formant-vocoder exists to serve speech-enhancement.

scientific-method DEPENDS_ON retroduction: the scientific method relies on retroduction (abduction/inference to the best explanation) for generating hypotheses and explanatory models from observations. Remove retroduction and the scientific method loses its primary hypothesis-formation mechanism — it can deduce and induce, but cannot abductively generate novel explanatory constructs. This is constitutive to scientific reasoning.

Iconography is a specific type of symbolic system — a collection of visual symbols with conventional meanings in a particular context. The nearest general kind is symbolic-system (a system of symbols and their interpretive rules). Direction: iconography (specific) → symbolic-system (general).

User feedback requires communication to operate — it is expressed through language, surveys, interviews, or other communicative channels. Remove communication and user feedback cannot be expressed, collected, or transmitted. The mechanism of user feedback IS communication.

The Butterworth filter is a signal filter specifically designed for signal processing applications — its purpose is to provide a maximally flat frequency response in the passband for signal processing tasks. Servant (butterworth-filter) points at master (signal-processing).
MCD computation requires MFCC vectors as input; remove MFCC computation and MCD cannot operate — removal test satisfied, Law 8. Dependency is object-level, not meta-level.

A conjecture is a proposed proposition offered to advance reasoning. It is built and maintained for the sake of inference — providing candidate claims to test, explore, and ultimately prove or disprove. Designed purpose: servant (conjecture) → master (inference). Law 8d satisfied.
Variational inference IS a specific kind of Bayesian inference: it approximates Bayesian posteriors via optimization. Specific→general.
Mask-based enhancement is a specific class of speech enhancement algorithms that use time-frequency masks. Specific→general INSTANCE_OF per Law 9.

State-space models represent systems through differential equations and state variables, serving signal processing by enabling optimal filtering (Kalman filter), prediction, and system identification. They serve the field by providing a mathematical framework for modeling and processing dynamic signals.

MLE is estimation in a specific, named sense: determining an unknown parameter by maximizing the likelihood of the observed data. It passes the nearest-kind test: 'estimation' is the general procedure for determining approximate values from partial information, and no accepted intermediate kind (parameter-estimation, likelihood-based method, ...) sits between. A competent practitioner says 'MLE is a method of estimation' without qualification. INSTANCE_OF against the nearest kind (Laws 9, 11e).

The Butterworth filter is a signal processing filter designed to have a frequency response as flat as possible in the passband. It depends on signal-processing — the theory, design, and application of Butterworth filters exist within the framework of signal processing.

Bias-variance decomposition is defined in terms of Var(f̂) as a component of the expected squared error. Remove variance from the mathematical vocabulary and the decomposition cannot be expressed or evaluated operationally; the formula ceases to operate. Law 8b removal test satisfied.

A formant vocoder synthesizes speech by modeling vocal tract resonances (formants) and serves speech processing by providing a parametric approach to speech analysis and synthesis. It is a tool used within speech processing pipelines for vocoder-based processing and analysis.

The Nyquist-Shannon sampling theorem is formulated and proved using Fourier transform theory — bandlimited signals are reconstructed from samples via the sinc interpolation formula, which is a direct consequence of the Fourier transform's frequency-domain properties. Remove the Fourier transform and the theorem's defining mechanism (bandlimited reconstruction) cannot operate. Constitutive dependency.

Phase retrieval reconstructs phase from magnitude spectrograms to restore perceptual quality of speech signals. It is built for the purpose of serving speech enhancement, servant points at master per Law 8d.

Formalism is a specific kind of philosophy — specifically a philosophy of mathematics. It holds that mathematics is a game of symbol manipulation governed by formal rules, independent of meaning or interpretation. A competent speaker would say 'formalism is a philosophy (of mathematics).' The nearest kind is philosophy, not logic (which would be a domain error per Law 9a).

Posterior distribution is computed via Bayes rule as proportional to likelihood times prior. Removing the prior removes the multiplicative factor; the posterior cannot be computed or operated as Bayesian update. Operational cessation.

Phase coherence quantifies consistency of phase relationships across frequency components or over time. Measuring consistency requires a phase response as input; without phase response data, coherence cannot be computed or assessed. Removal of phase response stops phase coherence operation.

Bayes factor is a statistic used to compare the evidence for two competing hypotheses. It is built and maintained for the sake of hypothesis testing — its entire purpose is to quantify relative evidence between H1 and H2. Law 8d: the servant (bayes-factor) points at the master (hypothesis-testing).

Law 7 which-came-first: Wiener (1949) is the frequency-domain minimum-mean-squared-error solution; Kalman (1960) is the recursive time-domain generalization of the same optimal-estimation problem, and the wiener-filter's own accepted definition closes by naming it 'the limit that Kalman filtering generalizes in the time domain.' Y existed first and fed into X. DERIVED_FROM, not DEPENDS_ON: the Kalman filter still operates without any Wiener filter present.

Jurisdiction is a legal construct that requires language to define its boundaries, express its rules, and enforce its scope. Remove language and jurisdiction cannot operate — legal boundaries become unexpressed, jurisdictional authority cannot be articulated. This is object-level: jurisdiction's mechanism IS linguistic articulation of authority domains, not merely needing language to be discussed.

Minimum-phase filters are defined by the Hilbert transform relationship between log-magnitude and phase in the frequency domain — a relationship computed via the Fourier transform. Remove the Fourier transform and the filter's defining property (minimum phase = phase uniquely determined by magnitude) cannot be computed or expressed. The Fourier transform is a constitutive operating requirement.
Speech enhancement is a specific signal-processing discipline for improving speech quality. Specific→general.

Cross-entropy H(p,q) = -Σ p(x) log q(x) is the extension of Shannon entropy H(p) = -Σ p(x) log p(x) to two distributions. The entropy concept (Shannon 1948) existed first and cross-entropy was derived from it — the cross-entropy formula is literally the negative expected log of q, while entropy is the same form with p=q. Entropy is the more fundamental construct that cross-entropy derives from.

Spectral flatness measure quantifies tonality vs noisiness per frame and is built for the sake of guiding noise suppression and quality assessment in speech enhancement pipelines; it is used as a feature to decide enhancement strength and to evaluate enhancement outcomes. Servant points at master per Law 8d.

Mask-based enhancement applies spectral or temporal masks to noisy signal representations to improve signal quality. It depends on signal-processing — without signal processing techniques for representation, masking, and reconstruction, mask-based enhancement has no operational framework.
Predictive distribution is the canonical Bayesian forecasting tool. Remove Bayesian inference framework and predictive distribution has no operational definition. Law 8b removal test satisfied.

KL-divergence is a specific f-divergence with generating function f(t) = t log(t). A competent speaker would call KL-divergence an f-divergence. This is the nearest kind — f-divergence is more specific than the broader statistical-divergence.
Phase vocoder is a specific implementation family within the broader vocoder technique class, using phase information for time-scale modification.

Cepstral analysis computes cepstral coefficients via a sequence of signal processing operations (FFT, log-power spectrum, DCT). Removing signal processing capability stops the entire computation pipeline. Present-tense constitutive dependency.

Posterior probability p(theta|x) = p(x|theta)pi(theta)/p(x) requires the marginal likelihood p(x) as its normalizing denominator. Without marginal likelihood, posterior probabilities cannot be computed at all. The removal of marginal likelihood means the posterior stops operating.

EM is literally the iterative algorithm that maximizes the evidence lower bound (ELBO). Remove ELBO and EM has no optimization target — the E-step computes expected complete-data log-likelihood via ELBO decomposition, the M-step maximizes it. Present-tense: EM ceases to operate without ELBO.

A prior distribution encodes prior beliefs about model parameters and is used to serve statistical inference — specifically Bayesian statistics. It serves the statistical enterprise by providing initial information that, combined with likelihood, yields posterior distributions for parameter estimation and uncertainty quantification.

AIC estimates the relative information loss of a statistical model — it is defined as −2·log-likelihood + 2k, where k is the number of parameters in the model. Remove statistical models and AIC has no definition. Constitutive dependency.

Pinned sense: equity is a SPECIFIC BODY of enforceable legal principles and remedies — the equitable half of the common-law order (maxims of conscience; remedies unavailable at law: injunctions, specific performance, trusts). Against the target's accepted definition — 'a framework of explicit, enforceable rules that bind conduct within a recognized jurisdiction, persisting through institutions (courts)' — equity's maxims are established rules that bind conduct, enforced by courts of chancery within the jurisdiction. A body of law is an instance of law: content of the legal order, not a mechanism serving it. Law 11d: judged against the target's accepted definition. This is the corrected relation for the mis-pinned SERVES edge.

KL divergence D_KL(P||Q) is a specific functional that maps two probability distributions to a non-negative real number measuring information loss. It satisfies the defining properties of statistical divergence: non-negativity and D=0 iff P=Q a.e. A competent speaker would classify KL divergence as a type of statistical divergence. Nearest kind is statistical-divergence.

Conditional entropy H(Y|X) = -Σ p(x,y) log p(y|x) is defined entirely in terms of probability distributions and the logarithm — its computation requires the entropy concept as its building block. Remove entropy and conditional entropy cannot be computed or defined: it IS entropy applied to conditional distributions. This passes the removal test of Law 8.

Natural gradient is a specific optimization algorithm that minimizes loss functions by preconditioning gradients with the Fisher information metric. Law 9: specific→nearest kind. A competent speaker calls natural gradient 'an optimization algorithm'. Nearest kind is optimization algorithm, not a more general category like algorithm.
Power divergence is a specific parametric family of statistical divergences between probability distributions (Cressie-Read class). It is a kind of statistical divergence.

Phase coherence is a measurable property developed to assess and improve the perceptual quality and intelligibility of speech signals, i.e., built for the purpose of serving speech enhancement. Servant points at master per Law 8d.

paradigm DEPENDS_ON theory: a paradigm is an organizing framework of shared theoretical commitments. Remove theory and a paradigm loses its explanatory content and stops functioning as a research framework. Paradigms operate by providing theories that define normal science — without theories, there is no paradigm, only a community.

Kalman filter is built or maintained for the sake of signal processing: its primary engineering application is denoising and tracking signals in noisy measurements. For whose sake? Signal processing. Servant (filter) → master (processing domain). Law 8d.

Cepstral distance measures the dissimilarity between two signals by first computing their cepstral coefficients (via cepstral analysis), then measuring the distance between the resulting coefficient vectors. Remove cepstral analysis, the coefficients cannot be computed, and distance measurement is impossible. Constitutive dependency.

An all-pass filter is a signal-processing filter built for the sake of phase coherence correction — its designed purpose is to reshape phase relationships across the spectrum while preserving magnitude, serving phase coherence management in audio and DSP chains. Servant→master per Law 8d.

Cepstral subtraction is a noise-suppression technique built specifically for the sake of improving speech intelligibility and quality; it estimates and removes the noise cepstrum to enhance speech. Servant points at master per Law 8d.

Cepstral-analysis methodology was developed after the cepstral domain concept (log-magnitude spectrum) was established by Oppenheim and Schafer. The cepstral domain (epoch 0.14) predates cepstral-analysis (epoch 0.77) and fed into it.

KL-divergence D_KL(P||Q) = Σ P(x) log(P(x)/Q(x)) = -Σ P(x) log Q(x) + Σ P(x) log P(x) = cross-entropy(P,Q) - entropy(P). The KL formula is literally decomposed into Shannon entropy terms. It was derived from the entropy concept by Kullback and Leibler (1951). Entropy (Shannon 1948) predates and feeds into KL-divergence.

Group delay is a specific signal-processing concept that measures the time delay of the envelope of a signal's spectral components as a function of frequency, defined as τg(ω) = −dφ(ω)/dω where φ is phase response. It is an instance of signal-processing — the discipline of algorithms and methods for analyzing and transforming signals. Sense pinned: group delay as the derivative-of-phase concept, not the colloquial sense of a delayed group acting.
Cepstral liftering operates on cepstral coefficients produced by cepstral analysis; the lifter weights are applied in the cepstral domain, so removal of the analysis leaves no coefficients to lifter.

Group delay is computed as the negative derivative of phase response with respect to frequency; remove phase response and group delay cannot be calculated or used operationally. Dependency is present-tense operational, not historical.
Remove bias from the decomposition formula and the decomposition no longer operates as specified; the bias term is an operational input, not merely sayable.

MLE operates on the log-likelihood ℓ(θ|x) = log L(θ|x) as its optimization objective. Remove log-likelihood and MLE has no function to maximize — the procedure stops operating. MLE is fundamentally defined through log-likelihood maximization, whether for analytical solutions or gradient-based optimization.

The sampling theorem describes conditions under which a continuous-time signal can be exactly reconstructed from its samples. It operates on signals — without signals, the sampling theorem has no subject matter. The theorem is about the relationship between continuous signals and their discrete representations.

CPP requires spectral decomposition to compute the power spectrum (step 2 of cepstrum calculation). Remove spectral-analysis and the cepstrum cannot be computed, so CPP stops operating. Present-tense constitutive dependency.
The scientific method CONTAINS falsifiability as a core criterion: a hypothesis must be falsifiable to qualify. Falsifiability is a component/part of the scientific method's structure.

Probit model is formulated using the cumulative distribution function of the standard normal distribution as its link function; its definition and operation are a direct derivation from normal distribution theory. Direction: probit-model derived from normal distribution.

Log-likelihood is built for the sake of statistical inference: inference methods (MLE, likelihood ratio tests) use the likelihood function as their operative tool. For whose sake? Inference. Servant (log-likelihood) points at master (statistical-inference). Law 8d.

Estoppel is built for the sake of the legal system — it serves law by preventing injustice and maintaining fairness in legal proceedings. The equitable doctrine exists as a servant of the broader legal framework, not as an end in itself.

The sampling practice preceded the theorem: Nyquist's 1928 condition on pulse rate arose inside telephony sampling practice, and Shannon's 1949 formulation generalized it. The theorem formalizes and bounds the pre-existing practice — it 'fixes the minimum rate for lossless reconstruction' of the sampled signal. Law 7: Y (the practice) existed first and fed into X (the theorem that systematized it).
Phase-vocoder operates on short-time Fourier transform magnitude and phase trajectories; removing spectral analysis capability stops the vocoder from operating.

Information geometry's dual affine connections and pythagorean theorem are derived from entropy and Kullback-Leibler divergence. The m-connection potential is the entropy functional; the e-connection potential is the log-partition function. The Fisher metric is the Hessian of the entropy potential in the dual coordinates. Remove entropy from the conceptual framework and the duality structure of information geometry collapses. The removal test passes at the object level.
Butterworth filter is designed and maintained for the sake of shaping frequency response in speech enhancement pipelines, providing maximally flat passband for noise shaping and equalization.

Speech enhancement is a sub-discipline built entirely from signal processing techniques — spectral subtraction, Wiener filtering, DFT-based processing, and other DSP algorithms are its operational mechanism. Remove signal processing and speech enhancement stops operating: there is no alternative methodology. DEPENDS_ON satisfies the removal test (Laws 2b/8b).

AIC is a specific kind of model selection criterion. A competent speaker would call AIC 'a model selection method.' The specific→general direction is correct for INSTANCE_OF. It is one of several model selection criteria (along with BIC, MDL, etc.), each implementing a different trade-off between fit and complexity.

The sampling theorem (Nyquist-Shannon) is a specific mathematical theorem about reconstructing continuous functions from discrete samples. A competent speaker would call the sampling theorem a theorem.

Falsifiability is a demarcation criterion constructed for the sake of scientific practice — it is maintained, taught, and applied to decide what counts as scientific. The criterion serves the method, not the reverse. Servant → master.

Variance Var(X) = E[(X − E[X])²] is a functional of a probability distribution. Remove the probability distribution and variance has no mathematical object to operate on — it ceases to exist. Direction correct: variance (epoch 0.99) depends on probability distribution (epoch 0), the most foundational construct. Variance is the second central moment, a specific functional computed from the distribution.

Cepstral peak prominence is computed from the cepstrum: the prominence is the magnitude of the peak in the real cepstrum. Remove the cepstrum and the prominence measure has no input and stops operating.
Spectral flatness measure is computed from a power spectrum; remove spectral analysis and the measure has no spectrum to evaluate, so it stops operating.

Input validation — checking that input data conforms to expected format, range, type, or constraints before processing — is a specific kind of validation. A competent speaker would call input validation 'a type of validation.'

cherry-pick is a specific technique of selectively using evidence, which is a kind of confirmation-bias. A competent speaker would call cherry-picking a type of confirmation bias. The specific→general direction is correct for INSTANCE_OF.

Cherry-picking — selectively citing evidence that supports a claim while ignoring contradicting evidence — is a specific manifestation of cognitive bias (confirmation bias variant). A competent speaker would call cherry-picking 'a type of cognitive bias.'

The cepstrum was invented by Bogert, Healy and Tukey specifically to detect periodic structures in spectra such as formant spacing. The concept of formants existed first and the cepstrum was developed as a technique for formant analysis.

A statistical divergence is defined as a functional D[P||Q] mapping two probability distributions to a non-negative real number; remove probability distributions and the divergence has no inputs and ceases to operate — operational dependency per Law 8 removal test.

A morphism is defined as a structure-preserving map between objects within a category. Remove the concept of a category and the concept of a morphism loses its entire framework — morphisms only exist as arrows between objects in a category. This passes Law 8's removal test: without category, morphism cannot be defined or operated.

EM is an iterative algorithm for performing maximum-likelihood estimation in models with latent variables. Its entire purpose is to find the MLE; without the MLE objective, the EM procedure has no reason to exist. Epoch test: MLE (0.01) is older than EM (0.01), arrow EM → MLE.
Bias-variance decomposition is computed on predictions of a statistical model; remove the model and the decomposition has no data to operate on.

Rumour is a type of information — specifically, unverified information transmitted informally. Direction: specific (rumour) → general (information). A competent speaker would say a rumour IS information (albeit unverified). This avoids my previous DEPENDS_ON errors (rumour→gossip struck, rumour→communication struck) by using INSTANCE_OF instead.

Statistical estimators (sample mean, MLE, etc.) are tools built specifically for the purpose of statistical inference. The estimator serves the inference process: remove inference as a goal and estimators have no purpose.

Idealization in mathematics requires mathematical formalism to operate — removing mathematics stops the idealization practice (parameterization, approximation, limit processes). Object-level dependency.

Regression analysis is a statistical method built and maintained for the sake of statistical inference — specifically for inferring relationships between variables and making predictions. Its primary purpose in practice is to serve statistical inference about data-generating processes. Law 8d: servant points at master.

Retroduction (abductive inference) is the logical process of inferring the best explanation from observed data. It needs logic to operate — without it, the reasoning mechanism that selects between competing explanations collapses. The removal test passes.

Mel-cepstral-distortion quantifies perceptual difference between utterances through mel-cepstral coefficient computation — a signal-processing technique. Remove signal-processing (the mathematical analysis and transformation of audio signals) and mel-cepstral-distortion cannot be computed or used. The metric depends on signal-processing for its core computational mechanism.

Canon is a specific type of law — a body of rules, principles, or standards established by an authoritative body (ecclesiastical council, legislative body, or professional organization) and recognized as binding. It files against law as the nearest kind. Note: a DERIVED_FROM edge already exists between canon and law, but INSTANCE_OF expresses a different relationship — canon is a kind/instance of the broader category of law, not merely derived from it.

Spectral-flatness-measure requires signal-processing techniques (FFT, power spectrum estimation) to operate — removing signal-processing means you cannot compute the power spectrum, and the measure ceases to function. This is an operating dependency, not merely a domain label.

decimation IS a DSP technique that reduces sample rate by an integer factor M. Its mechanism (anti-aliasing filtering + downsampling) requires signal-processing fundamentals. Remove signal-processing and decimation has no framework.

Pitch-synchronous is a specific type of vocoder technique that operates on a per-frame or per-syllable basis rather than on a continuous frame-by-frame analysis approach. It IS a kind of vocoder. Direction: specific→general. Law 9 satisfied.

Pinned sense: quorum as a VALIDITY threshold — a defined crossing point between two states of a deliberative body's proceedings (voidable/no-binding-action vs valid/binding). Maps onto threshold's accepted parameters: the two sides it separates (validity states), the mark of the boundary (a count — fixed number or fraction), and the conditions for crossing (the required members present). Specific→general (Law 9); threshold is the NEAREST kind on the board (Law 11e) — quorum is a boundary value, not an institution (court), not a practice (governance), not an instruction (rule), and not a member of the law framework.

CPP quantifies periodicity strength in a signal and is extracted as a feature specifically to support signal processing pipelines — speech enhancement, voice activity detection, and quality assessment all rely on it. The metric exists within signal processing practice and serves the discipline's analytical goals.

f-divergence family is constructed as a unifying measure of difference between distributions for comparing models, selecting estimators, and quantifying information loss. It is built for the sake of statistical inference tasks such as model selection, hypothesis testing, and information quantification.

KL is the canonical f-divergence: D_KL(P||Q) = D_f(P||Q) with generating function f(t) = t ln t, which is strictly convex with f(1)=0 - exactly the defining signature of the f-divergence kind. This is the NEAREST kind (Law 9/11e): f-divergence sits between KL and statistical-divergence, and f-divergence INSTANCE_OF statistical-divergence is already ACCEPTED. Filing this rung completes the ladder KL->f-divergence->statistical-divergence, so the coarser KL->statistical-divergence leap (pending, which I ADVANCEd as not-yet-derivable) is retired as SUBSUMED without penalty.

MFCCs are a specific kind of cepstral coefficient — ones computed by applying a mel-scale filterbank to the magnitude spectrum before taking the DCT. The specific→general direction is correct: MFCC is a mel-scaled variant of the general cepstral coefficient concept. Both share the same core computation pattern (spectral analysis → coefficient extraction) with MFCC being a specialized instance.

power-divergence D_alpha = (1/(alpha*(alpha-1))) sum(p^alpha q^(1-alpha) - ...) = sum(q_i * f(p_i/q_i)) with f(t) = (t^alpha - alpha*t + alpha - 1)/(alpha*(alpha-1)). This satisfies the f-divergence form D_F(P||Q) = sum(q_i * F(p_i/q_i)) where F convex, F(1)=0. Specific instance of general f-divergence class.

Homomorphic filtering applies cepstral analysis techniques to separate multiplicative components in a signal. The method derives from cepstral analysis — the homomorphic signal is computed via cepstral-domain processing (FFT→log→inverse FFT). Historically, cepstral analysis came first; homomorphic filtering was developed as a specialized application. Which-came-first: cepstral analysis → homomorphic filtering.

Model-averaging is a specific kind of ensemble learning: multiple models' predictions are combined (via weighting by model quality) rather than equally averaged. A competent speaker calls model-averaging a type of ensemble learning. Nearest kind: ensemble learning (the general paradigm of combining multiple models).

Wiener filter operates on spectral data to separate signal from noise. Removing spectral-analysis removes the spectral input representation on which the Wiener filter computes its frequency-dependent gain. Constitutive: without spectral analysis providing the spectral framework, the Wiener filter has no input to process.
Grammar is a structural system that constitutes part of language — a specific kind of language construct. INSTANCE_OF from specific to general.

Jensen-Shannon divergence is an f-divergence with generating function f(t) = t·log(2t/(t+1)), a strictly convex function with f(1)=0. Every JS divergence is a specific f-divergence, and a competent speaker would classify it as 'a type of f-divergence'. f-divergence is the nearest kind between JS and the broader statistical-divergence.

Variational inference as an optimization procedure depends on the ELBO: VI finds q* by optimizing the ELBO objective. Remove the ELBO and variational inference has no optimization target — the procedure stops operating. ELBO epoch 0.01 predates VI epoch 0.06 per epoch test, confirming the arrow.

Canonical forms, references, and standards are built for the purpose of serving truth — they aim to establish the authoritative or most accurate representation. The canonical is designed to approximate truth in a domain. Servant→master per Law 8d.
Isomorphism IS a specific kind of analogy: it denotes a structural correspondence between two systems where elements map one-to-one preserving relations. Specific→general. Nearest kind is analogy.

Probit model is a specific kind of regression model for binary outcomes — a generalized linear model with probit link function. A competent speaker calls a probit model 'a type of regression.' Nearest kind: regression (not a leap — regression is the direct parent category for model families like linear, logistic, and probit).

ELBO's designed purpose is to provide a tractable lower bound on log marginal likelihood (model evidence). It exists for the sake of computing model evidence when the integral is intractable. In variational inference, maximizing ELBO is how we approximate log p(x). Servant (ELBO) → master (marginal-likelihood). Law 8d.
HNR requires identification of pitch-related partials to sum harmonic energy and separate noise residual. Without pitch estimation the harmonic component cannot be isolated, so HNR stops operating.

Variational inference is built for the sake of statistical inference: it is a computational method that approximates Bayesian posteriors to enable inference when exact methods are intractable. For whose sake? Inference. Servant (VI) → master (statistical-inference). Law 8d.

AIC is built for the sake of model selection: it was explicitly designed as a criterion for selecting among statistical models by estimating relative information loss. For whose sake? Model selection. Servant (AIC) → master (model-selection). Law 8d.
Digital ledger IS a specific kind of ledger: it is a digital/electronic record-keeping system, often distributed. Specific→general. Nearest kind is 'ledger'.

Marginal likelihood p(x) = ∫ p(x|θ)π(θ)dθ is derived from the likelihood function p(x|θ) by integrating over the parameter space weighted by the prior. Likelihood was formalized by Fisher in the 1920s; marginal likelihood (model evidence) came later as the Bayesian extension. The likelihood is the base construct; marginal likelihood is its integrated variant.
Formalism as a philosophical approach to mathematics depends on mathematics — without the subject matter of mathematics, formalism has no domain in which to operate.

Syllogism operates as a deductive reasoning form that requires logic to validate its structure — premises, inferences, and conclusions depend on logical criteria to distinguish valid from invalid forms. Remove logic (the study and principles of valid reasoning) and syllogism loses its framework for determining whether a deduction is valid. This is a genuine operational dependency: the practice of syllogistic reasoning requires logical criteria to function.

Differential entropy integrates log-density values; log-likelihood provides the fundamental logarithmic probability function that both differential entropy and log-likelihood itself operate on. The removal of log-probability computation destroys the structural basis of differential entropy.

Conditional entropy H(Y|X) extends Shannon entropy H(X) to the setting of dependent variables. Entropy existed first (Shannon 1948) and conditional entropy was derived from it by introducing the conditioning variable. The chain rule H(X,Y)=H(X)+H(Y|X) shows conditional entropy as the extension of entropy to joint distributions.

Syllogism is a specific form of deductive reasoning: a structured argument where conclusions follow necessarily from premises. Direction: specific (syllogism) → general (deductive-reasoning). A competent speaker would call syllogism a deductive-reasoning pattern. Nearest kind: deductive-reasoning is more specific than logic (my previous DEPENDS_ON→logic error), and syllogism IS a kind of deductive-reasoning.

The phase-locked vocoder is a speech synthesis technique specifically designed for speech processing — its purpose is to process and synthesize speech signals with phase coherence. Servant (phase-locked-vocoder) points at master (speech-processing).

Pinned sense (Law 11d): the classic Butterworth design as realized recursively — the maximally-flat prototype |H(jw)|=1/sqrt(1+(w/wc)^(2N)) carried to the digital domain by bilinear transform, with poles inside the unit circle and feedback in the difference equation. That realization is a specific member of the recursive filter class: a competent speaker calls a Butterworth IIR section an IIR filter. Nearest kind (Law 11e): iir-filter — no nearer recursive-kind rung exists in the web. FIR approximations of the Butterworth magnitude are a secondary sense, not the pinned one.

KL divergence D_KL(P||Q) = -∑ P(x) log Q(x) + ∑ P(x) log P(x) = cross-entropy(P,Q) - entropy(P). KL is decomposed as cross-entropy minus entropy. Shannon introduced cross-entropy (1948) first; KL (Kullback-Leibler, 1951) was derived from it as a divergence measure. Which-came-first: cross-entropy predates KL divergence.

MFCC computation requires multiple signal processing steps: FFT for spectral analysis, mel filterbank application, and DCT. Each step is a signal processing operation — removing signal processing stops the entire MFCC pipeline. Present-tense constitutive dependency.

A canon is a bounded collection of texts whose selection principle is authority/orthodoxy — exactly the corpus parameter that determines membership. The canon of literature, scripture, and music is a corpus of works filtered by canonical status; a competent speaker calls the canon a corpus. Law 9: X is a specific kind of Y, and corpus is the NEAREST kind (no narrower 'authoritative text collection' exists). Sense pinned to the primary works/texts reading; 'canon of principles' is the secondary sense.

Cepstral peak prominence quantifies periodicity strength per frame and is built for the sake of voice-activity-detection tasks where periodicity discriminates speech from non-speech. The metric is used as a feature to drive VAD decisions; remove CPP and VAD loses a periodicity-based cue and its operation degrades. Servant points at master per Law 8d.

Phase coherence measurement requires the concept of audio phase as its input representation; remove audio phase and phase coherence cannot be evaluated or computed, so the construct stops operating. Operational dependency, not merely sayable. Law 8b removal test satisfied.

Falsifiability as a theory of knowledge criterion depends on epistemology — without epistemology's framework for evaluating belief justification, falsifiability cannot serve as a demarcation standard.

Law 8d 'for whose sake?': EM is built to find maximum-likelihood (and MAP) parameter estimates in models with unobserved latent variables — that estimation task is its designed purpose, and its two steps (E-step posterior, M-step maximization of the expected complete-data log-likelihood) exist only to produce the MLE. Servant (the iterative algorithm) points at master (the estimation method it was built for). Service need not be exclusive (it also serves MAP estimation); the pinned sense is MLE as the primary designed target.

audio-dithering IS a DSP technique that adds noise before quantization to decorrelate quantization error. Its entire mechanism (noise shaping, amplitude control, bit-depth processing) requires signal-processing fundamentals. Remove signal-processing and audio dithering stops operating.

Chi-squared divergence is constructed as a computationally convenient divergence for comparing distributions, specifically used within goodness-of-fit testing and model comparison. It is built for the sake of evaluating how well a model fits observed data, i.e., it serves goodness-of-fit practice.

A Kalman filter IS a specific kind of statistical estimator: it estimates hidden states from noisy measurements using a recursive rule. Specific→general mapping against the nearest kind (statistical-estimator). Law 9.

Phase response is a specific signal-processing concept describing the frequency-dependent phase shift introduced by a system, expressed as the argument (angle) of the complex frequency response H(jω). It is an instance of signal-processing — the discipline of algorithms and methods for analyzing and transforming signals. Sense pinned: phase response as the angular component of frequency response, not the colloquial sense of reacting to something.

The score function s(θ) = ∂/∂θ log p(x|θ) predates Fisher information. Fisher information I(θ) = E[s(θ)²] is defined as the expected squared score. Historical: score function used in likelihood theory before Fisher formalized the information concept (1925).
cepstral-coefficients are computed via signal-processing operations (FFT, log, DCT). Removing signal-processing stops the computation pipeline. Present-tense removal test passes.

Mutual information I(X;Y) = D_KL(p(x,y) || p(x)p(y)) — its definition is literally the KL-divergence between the joint distribution and the product of marginals. Remove KL-divergence and mutual-information has no definition. Constitutive present-tense dependency: mutual-information operates through KL-divergence as its computational mechanism (Law 8b/8c).

Speech intelligibility measures how well spoken language is understood by a listener. It depends on psychoacoustics — the study of how the human auditory system perceives sound — because intelligibility is fundamentally about perceptual processing: how the brain decodes acoustic signals. Without psychoacoustics as the framework for understanding auditory perception, speech-intelligibility cannot operate as a measurable concept.

The sampling theorem (Nyquist-Shannon) establishes the conditions for perfect reconstruction of continuous signals from discrete samples and serves signal processing by providing the foundational principle for all digital signal processing — without it, the conversion from analog to digital would lack theoretical guarantees.

Conjecture is the activity of forming a tentative explanation or hypothesis for further investigation. It requires logic as its operating framework — without logic, conjecture cannot formulate propositions, evaluate consistency, or guide inference. The removal test passes: remove logic and conjecture loses its reasoning mechanism entirely.

Self-information I(x) = -log p(x) shares the log-probability structure with log-likelihood L(θ) = log p(x|θ), which predates self-information historically (Fisher 1920s vs Shannon 1948). The mathematical operation of taking the log of a probability density is the common building block; self-information specializes this to the negative for a single event under its own distribution. Which came first: log-likelihood as a structural concept (yes). DERIVED_FROM tests historical precedence and conceptual lineage.

A scheme is a specific kind of classification system — it organizes items into categories or types (e.g. classification schemes in biology, library science). 'A scheme is a kind of classification system.'

Phase coherence is a signal-processing metric that requires DSP algorithms (DFT/STFT analysis, phase extraction, correlation computation) to measure. Remove signal processing and phase coherence has no mechanism for measurement or computation. This is a constitutive dependency.

A conjecture is a proposition asserted without complete proof — its identity as a conjecture is constitutively dependent on having the concept of proposition (a declarative statement that can be true or false). Without proposition, conjecture cannot exist as a category. Direction: conjecture (newer, dependent) → proposition (older, foundational).
Retroduction is a named historical form of abductive reasoning; specific instance of the general abductive class, nearest kind.

The Rényi divergence is a named family of statistical divergences — the umbrella's own accepted definition names it explicitly: 'the Kullback–Leibler, Jensen–Shannon, chi-squared, and Rényi families are all special cases or variants of the broader concept of statistical divergence.' Law 11e nearest kind: it is NOT an f-divergence (its (1/(α−1))·log Σ P^α Q^(1−α) form does not reduce to the f-divergence form f(t) = t·f′(1/(1−t)) family), so statistical-divergence — the accepted umbrella that names it — is the nearest existing kind. A statistician says 'Rényi divergence is a statistical divergence'. Specific → general.

Formant vocoder extracts formant frequencies, bandwidths and excitation parameters from speech spectra per frame. Removing spectral analysis removes the input representation on which formant tracking operates, so the vocoder cannot perform analysis or synthesis.

Fisher information I(θ) = Var(∂/∂θ log L(θ;X)) = E[(∂/∂θ log L)²]. It is the variance of the score function — remove the score function and Fisher information has no definable quantity. The score is the fundamental object; Fisher info is a moment of it.

Specific to general (Law 9): the Wiener filter is a filter in the target's pinned sense — its accepted definition's frequency-domain solution H(f) = S_x(f)/(S_x(f)+S_n(f)) is exactly a designed transfer function that selectively passes or attenuates frequency components (weighted by local SNR), matching the accepted def of 'filter' (selective pass/attenuation per designed transfer function). Nearest kind (Law 11e): no 'optimal-filter' or 'adaptive-filter' rung exists, and iir-filter is the wrong rung — the Wiener filter is defined by the MMSE criterion, not recursion; finite-length Wiener solutions are FIR. Servant-of relations (SERVES speech-enhancement) are a separate matter; this pins the kind-membership sense.

Merge conflict is an artifact that arises when version-control detects incompatible divergences in a file's history and cannot auto-reconcile them. Removing version-control removes the history tracking and merge operation that produce the conflict, so the conflict cannot be generated or persisted.

Log-likelihood computation requires the likelihood function which itself depends on probability distributions; KL divergence is the canonical divergence between distributions that log-likelihood evaluates, and the mathematical structure of likelihood underpins how KL divergence measures information loss.

Fisher information I(θ) = E[(∂/∂θ log L(θ;X))²] = -E[∂²/∂θ² log L(θ;X)] operates directly on log-likelihood. Remove log-likelihood and Fisher information has no mathematical object to differentiate or evaluate — it ceases to exist. Direction correct: Fisher information (derived concept) depends on log-likelihood (the object it operates on). Note: Fisher info can also be defined via the score function's variance, but score-function itself depends on log-likelihood.

A syllogism is a specific form of deductive reasoning where a conclusion is drawn from two or more premises. A competent speaker would call a syllogism 'a form of deduction.' This files against the nearest kind.

Fisher information was derived from studying the likelihood function: it quantifies the curvature of the log-likelihood, measuring how much information the observable random variable carries about an unknown parameter. Fisher (1925) derived this from the likelihood's second derivative — which-came-first: likelihood function predates Fisher information.

A sufficient statistic T(X) is defined by the factorization P(X|theta) = g(T(X),theta)·h(X) — the likelihood function. Remove likelihood and the concept of sufficiency has no mechanism to operate on. Present-tense operational necessity: sufficient statistics extract information from likelihood, not from data alone.

Ensemble learning needs models as its building blocks: the technique combines multiple models' predictions to produce improved results. Remove models and ensemble learning collapses — there are no base predictions to combine. This passes the removal test: the mechanism literally operates on models.

FIR filters operate on discrete-time digital signals. The sampling theorem (Nyquist-Shannon) provides the theoretical foundation for converting continuous signals to discrete form — without it, digital signal processing including FIR filtering has no theoretical basis for how continuous signals can be faithfully represented in discrete form.

Spectral flatness is computed from the power spectrum: the measure is the ratio of geometric mean to arithmetic mean of the spectral power values. Remove the power spectrum and the flatness calculation has no input and stops operating.

Mel-cepstral distortion is a distance metric computed from mel-frequency cepstral coefficients — it quantifies spectral distortion between reference and processed speech by comparing coefficient vectors. The removal test passes: without cepstral coefficients as the computational substrate, the distortion metric cannot be computed or operate. Direction: mel-cepstral-distortion depends on cepstral-coefficients.

Cepstral mean normalization operates on cepstral coefficients produced by cepstral analysis; without the analysis output there is nothing to normalize. Removing cepstral analysis prevents the mean normalization step from operating on the intended data.

Phase-locked vocoder extracts and manipulates phase information from speech frames within the speech-processing pipeline. Removing speech-processing removes the frame-based analysis, phase estimation, and synthesis pipeline that the vocoder operates within. Constitutive: without speech-processing providing this pipeline, the phase-locked vocoder has no operational framework.

A minimum-phase filter is a signal processing construct whose defining property (minimum phase shift for given magnitude response) serves the practical needs of signal processing — ensuring causal, stable inverse filtering and minimal delay. Its design purpose is signal processing applications. Law 8d: servant points at master.
Formant vocoder is a specific implementation family within the broader vocoder technique class.
Mindfulness is a specific cognitive practice and attentional regulation technique. Clean specific→general INSTANCE_OF (Law 9).

AIC = 2k - 2log(L) requires a statistical model: k is the number of free parameters, L is the maximum likelihood from fitting the model. Remove the statistical model and AIC ceases to operate — no model to count parameters from, no likelihood to evaluate. AIC is a model-comparison tool, not a standalone formula.

Bayes factor IS the ratio of marginal likelihoods. Remove marginal likelihood — you cannot compute a Bayes factor. Present-tense operational necessity: every Bayes factor computation requires evaluating marginal likelihoods under each model.

Harmonic-to-noise ratio is a voice-quality metric built for the purpose of assessing and controlling periodicity in speech enhancement; it is used to guide dereverberation and noise suppression decisions and to evaluate enhancement quality. Servant points at master per Law 8d.

Gossip is built for the purpose of facilitating social communication — it circulates information, builds social bonds, and maintains group knowledge through informal channels. The servant (gossip) points at the master (communication). While it already has INSTANCE_OF→communication, SERVES adds the teleological dimension.

Deposition requires the legal framework to operate — a deposition is a sworn out-of-court testimony governed by procedural rules of law. Remove law and depositions lose their legal standing, procedural rules, and enforcement mechanism. They stop operating as legal instruments.

Bayes factors are built and maintained for the purpose of Bayesian model selection — they quantify evidence for one model over another to enable model choice. Servant (bayes-factor) points at master (model-selection). Per Law 8d: this records designed purpose, not constitutive need.

Score function U(θ;x)=∂/∂θ log L(θ;x) is defined only for a parametric statistical model p(x|θ). Remove the statistical model and the score has no parameter space, no likelihood, and no gradient to compute; it ceases to operate. Removal test satisfied.

Cross-entropy is used as the standard loss function for classification tasks, especially multi-class classification with softmax outputs. It is built and maintained for the sake of classification — quantifying the difference between predicted probability distributions and true class labels. Law 8d: servant (cross-entropy) points at master (classification).

Mel-cepstral distortion quantifies perceptual difference by computing RMS deviation of mel-cepstral coefficients. Remove cepstral analysis and the coefficients cannot be derived, so the metric stops operating.

A pull request is an operational mechanism within version control systems — it requires the version control system (repository, branches, diffs) to function. Remove version control and a pull request cannot be created, merged, or reviewed. The which-came-first test: version-control predates pull-requests historically.

Isomorphism requires abstraction to operate: identifying structural equivalence between two systems demands abstracting away their specific differences to see the shared form. Remove abstraction and isomorphism collapses — you cannot recognize structural sameness without abstracting details. This is the operating dependency, not mere conceptual dependence.

The likelihood function was formalized by R.A. Fisher in the 1920s, treating the probability of the data as a function of the unknown parameters. The log-likelihood is the later computational re-parameterization: the natural logarithm of that function, adopted because it turns products into sums and makes maximum-likelihood optimization numerically stable — and its own accepted definition states it is 'the natural logarithm of the likelihood function'. The likelihood came first and gives rise to the log-likelihood; hence log-likelihood DERIVED_FROM likelihood (Law 7: which came first).

MLE estimates parameters of a statistical model — the model defines the likelihood family p(x|θ). Remove statistical models and MLE has no parameter space, no likelihood family, nothing to estimate. Epoch test confirms: MLE (0.01) newer than statistical-model (0), arrow MLE → statistical-model.

Formant vocoder operates on speech spectral data to manipulate formant structure. Without speech-processing providing the pipeline for spectral analysis, form extraction, and parameter estimation, the vocoder cannot operate — the removal test passes.

Probit model is a specific kind of statistical model used for binary outcome prediction. A competent speaker calls a probit model a type of model. Nearest kind: model (not a leap — model is the direct parent category).
Chi-squared divergence is the f-divergence generated by φ(t)=(t-1)². It is a specific kind of f-divergence, with its convex function parameter fixing the divergence family.

Mutual information I(X;Y) = H(Y) - H(Y|X) is derived from the conditional entropy formula. Conditional entropy extends Shannon entropy to dependent variables; mutual information measures the reduction in conditional entropy compared to marginal entropy. Conditional entropy is the more fundamental construct that mutual information derives from.

Model averaging operates by combining predictions from multiple models with weights derived from their fit. Remove models and the averaging mechanism has no inputs to combine; the process stops operating. Operational removal test passes.

f-divergence is a specific family of statistical divergences parameterized by a convex function f; every f-divergence is a statistical divergence, and a competent speaker would classify it as 'a type of statistical divergence'.
